newsitem.title: ESTONIA: CORRECTION ENDS, INVESTORS WAIT FOR TREND.
newsitem.headline: CORRECTION ENDS, INVESTORS WAIT FOR TREND.

text.p: Estonian shares rallied on
Thursday after a brief correction and bout of profit-taking and
dealers were uncertain which direction the market would move
in.
Total trade on the main list was 83.7 million kroons as the
Talse index recovered to gain 1.31 percent to close at 403.55.
Hansapank was the most active stock with 37.7 million
kroons traded to gain 0.50 kroons for a close of 217 kroons.
"The correction finished this morning and prices are
holding," one trader said.
"Volumes are down as investors wait for a clear trend, with
many waiting for a rise to start," another dealer said.
Foreskpank added seven kroons to close at 225.50 kroons
after trade of 18.5 million kroons.
On the free market, total trade was 20.4 million kroons
with privatisation vouchers the most traded.
The privatisation securities were up to 0.44 kroons from
0.42 kroons with 17.5 million kroons traded.
"This rise started yesterday with the news that the
privatisation agency will allow more companies to be partly
purchased with the vouchers," another trader said.
-- Tallinn newsroom, +372 620 9202, reuters@reuters.ee
